run_depth2img_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionDepth2ImgPipeline to generate depth-guided images from a prompt and input image
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method
prepare_depth_map: prepare a normalized depth map from an input image using the DPT depth estimator
prepare_latents: prepare noisy initial latents from an input image for the denoising process
retrieve_latents: retrieve latent tensors from a VAE encoder output using sample or argmax mode
